description: Senior CS student specializing in backend systems, GIS, and data mining (Node.js, Python, React, PostgreSQL). For the MODIS & VIIRS Hot Spots challenge, I’m building an automated WGS 84 geospatial pipeline using spatial clustering to resolve 1 km vs. 375 m sensor mismatches into a live wildfire dashboard. Backend and cloud deployment are moving fast—looking for teammates skilled in GIS, Frontend visualization (Leaflet/React), or video storytelling to ship!
